name: Bird Dog
cues: On all fours with a flat back;Extend the opposite arm and leg

name: Dead Bug
cues: Press lower back into the floor;Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly

name: Prone Cobra Hold
cues: Lie face down and lift the chest and legs;Squeeze the shoulder blades;Reps are seconds

name: Prone Swimmer
cues: Lie face down and alternate lifting opposite arm and leg;Keep the movements small

name: Superman
injury_cautions: Do not over-arch the lower back
cues: Lie face-down and lift arms and legs;Squeeze glutes and upper back

name: Butt Kicks
cues: Run in place while kicking the heels to the glutes;Stay on the balls of the feet

name: High Knees
injury_cautions: Low-impact march if the joints hurt
cues: Drive knees to hip height;Stay on the balls of the feet

name: Inchworm
cues: Walk the hands out to a plank and walk the feet in;Keep the legs as straight as possible

name: Jumping Jacks
injury_cautions: Low-impact step version if the joints hurt
cues: Land softly on the balls of the feet;Keep a steady rhythm

name: Lateral Shuffle
cues: Shuffle sideways in a low athletic stance;Keep the feet from crossing

name: Seal Jacks
cues: Jump the feet wide while swinging the arms out and clapping;Keep the arms straight

name: Squat Jacks
cues: Jump the feet wide into a squat and back;Keep the chest up

name: Clamshell
cues: Lie on your side with the knees bent;Open the top knee without rolling the hips

name: Donkey Kick
cues: Start on hands and knees and kick one leg back;Squeeze the glute at the top

name: Fire Hydrant
cues: Start on hands and knees and lift one knee to the side;Keep the hips square

name: Resistance Band Hip Abduction
cues: Place the band around the thighs and stand tall;Press the leg out to the side

name: Resistance Band Lateral Walk
cues: Place the band around the thighs or ankles;Take small side steps in a quarter squat;Reps are seconds

name: 90-90 Hip Switch
cues: Sit with both knees bent at 90 degrees;Rotate the knees from side to side

name: Cat-Cow
cues: Round and arch the back in time with your breathing;Move through the whole spine

name: Deep Squat Hold
injury_cautions: Use a support if the heels lift
cues: Sit in a deep squat with the heels down;Keep the chest tall;Reps are seconds

name: World's Greatest Stretch
cues: Step into a lunge and reach the arm to the ceiling;Switch sides

name: Cable External Rotation
variations: Standing or kneeling; left and right arm
cues: Elbow tucked to the side at pulley height;Rotate the forearm away from the stomach

name: Dumbbell Side-Lying External Rotation
variations: Left and right arm; towel under the elbow
cues: Lie on your side with the elbow against the ribs;Rotate the forearm up and lower slowly

name: Kettlebell Halo
cues: Hold the bell upside down at the chest and circle the head;Keep the ribs down

name: Plate Halo
variations: Both directions; dumbbell or kettlebell instead
cues: Hold a plate at chest height and circle it around the head with elbows close;Keep the ribs down

name: Prone Y-T-W
cues: Lie face down and lift the arms into Y, T, and W shapes;Keep the neck neutral

name: Resistance Band External Rotation
cues: Anchor the band at elbow height;Rotate the forearm outward with the elbow at the side

name: Resistance Band Face Pull
injury_cautions: Make sure the anchor is secure
cues: Anchor at face height and pull toward the face;Elbows high

name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart
cues: Hold the band at chest height with straight arms;Pull apart until arms are out to the sides

name: Reverse Snow Angel
injury_cautions: Do not over-arch the lower back
cues: Lie face down with arms by the sides;Sweep the arms up and overhead

name: Scapular Pull-Up
injury_cautions: Keep the movement small and slow
variations: Pronated or neutral grip; Pause at the top (2 s); Active hang for time
cues: Hang with straight arms, assistance at zero;Pull the shoulder blades down without bending the elbows

name: Scapular Push-Up
cues: Keep the arms straight and move only the shoulder blades;Protract then retract
